articles.title: Hawaii's Secret Road Recipe: Old Fishing Nets and Ocean Plastic!
articles.summary: Hawaii is pulling 90 tons of plastic trash from the ocean—including old fishing nets—and mixing it into asphalt to pave roads. Scientists are testing if the roads shed tiny plastic bits. It's the first state to try this with marine debris.

articles.title: This Ancient Croc Cousin Walked Like a Dinosaur—and Had a Beak!
articles.summary: Scientists found a weird Triassic reptile called Labrujasuchus expectatus that looked like an ostrich dinosaur but was actually a crocodile relative. It walked on two legs, had tiny arms, and a toothless beak. The fossil fills a gap in croc evolution.

articles.title: A Brother Lost, a Hospital Closed: One Town's Fight for Emergency Care
articles.summary: Stanley Sears died of a heart attack in Martin County, N.C., a year after its only hospital closed. His sister Debra still wonders if he could have been saved. A $50 billion rural health fund offers hope, but the county can't use it to reopen the hospital.
